remarks: Extraordinary and very rare opportunity to own mixed-use real estate in North Stamford! Grandfathered in as a non-conforming contractors' storage and material yard, this special find offers an adorable 2-bedroom vintage home + a 3-bay garage with 1224 square feet, large doors, high ceilings, deep bays + storage loft which will accommodate 6 vehicles or large scale professional contracting equipment. Possibilities like this in North Stamford are extremely uncommon and offer ideal opportunity for professionals, investors as well as collectors. Property to be sold "As is".
